name: Warm Mustard-and-Vinegar Red Potato Salad
sub: Red potatoes · 4 side servings · estimated macros
text:
POTATO PREPARATION
Scrub 1½ lb red potatoes; leave skins on and cut into ¾-inch pieces. Cover with cold water by an inch, salt lightly, bring to a gentle boil, and simmer 10–15 minutes until just fork-tender. Drain well and spread out for 5–10 minutes.

INGREDIENTS
1½ lb red potatoes (prepared above)
1 tbsp olive oil
½ cup finely diced onion
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp water
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1–2 tsp allulose (optional)
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp smoked paprika
½ cup diced celery
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley OR 2 tsp dried
Salt and black pepper to taste

METHOD
1. Heat olive oil over medium heat. Cook onion 4–5 minutes until softened.
2. Stir in vinegar, water, mustard, optional allulose, garlic powder, and paprika; heat 30 seconds.
3. Gently fold in warm potatoes and celery until coated.
4. Remove from heat, add parsley, and rest 10 minutes.
5. Adjust vinegar, pepper, and salt. Serve warm or chilled.

ESTIMATED MACROS
Per ¼ batch: 166 kcal · 3.8 g protein · 30.1 g carbs · 3.8 g fat · 3.7 g fiber.
Whole batch: 663 kcal · 15.2 g protein · 120.5 g carbs · 15.3 g fat.
Saved estimate excludes optional allulose and uses fresh parsley.

NUTRITION STATUS
Generic estimates saved from conversation, October 25, 2026; not calculated from saved brand labels. Each recipe makes 4 side servings. A serving is ¼ of the finished batch, not a fixed weight. Brand, bacon size, and optional ingredients affect totals.
Refrigerate leftovers and use within 3–4 days.
